Hi Ana — great to hear from you. Appreciate the target timeline; we've put together a short mutual action plan and a billing-entitlements draft to make the PO path clear. Key notes up front:

1) If Helio purchases via GCP Marketplace (SaaS), GCP will bill Helio and remit to Redwood per the marketplace payout schedule. Invoices will show Marketplace SKU lines (usage or subscription depending on the listing).

2) Typical seller registration + listing activation to support co-sell takes ~7–10 business days if paperwork (W9, tax, banking) is complete. DocuSign can speed signature steps.

3) We have a SOC 2 summary and a short compliance bundle (pdf) for InfoSec review — attached.

Proposed immediate next steps (attached MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Today: Share contact info + SOC2 summary (done)
- 2027-07-14: Kickoff call with GCP partner enablement + Helio billing
- 2027-07-16: Seller registration paperwork submitted to GCP
- 2027-07-19: DocuSign exchange + PO confirmation

I've attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOC2_Summary.pdf. Also attaching a draft "marketplace_terms_draft.docx" that covers basic marketplace terms and billing mapping.

Can you confirm Helio's billing contact and whether you need a subscription SKU (monthly) or metered usage SKU?

Best,
